criticalStep.description: Observe system response immediately after clicking Order

triedStrategies.strategy: Observe role=alert after clicking Order button

sapBehaviorAnalysis.expected: A dedicated success notification containing the 10-digit PO number (e.g., 'Purchase Order 4500065XXX created successfully')
sapBehaviorAnalysis.actual: role=alert with text 'Purchase order has been created.' — no PO number anywhere in the notification
sapBehaviorAnalysis.pattern: SAP transitions immediately to Manage Purchase Orders list page after alert dismisses
sapBehaviorAnalysis.poNumberLocation: NOT in alert; PO number would appear in the document heading if user navigates back to the PO
sapBehaviorAnalysis.acViolated: AC-6: A unique Standard Purchase Order number is generated and displayed upon successful order submission

scriptPatchRecommendation.patchDescription: Fix openSearch() timing issue: add waitForSelector for the shell bar to be fully loaded before attempting to click Open Search. This allows the Playwright runner to reach Step 22 and surface the ASSERTION_FAILURE directly.
scriptPatchRecommendation.patchNote: Patching the navigation bug does not affect the designed-to-fail outcome — TC-CS-021 will still FAIL at Step 22 after the navigation is fixed.

escalation.reason: SAP behavior confirmed to violate AC-6. PO number is NOT displayed in success notification.
